reviews.author: vishu-bh
reviews.body:
Hey @marekdano 👋 — the component split here is clean and the controlled-state
pattern for `CustomHeadersAuth` and `BearerTokenAuth` is the right approach.
A few things noticed in review

---

### 🔴 Blockers

**OAuth2Auth mixed controlled/uncontrolled state**
`OAuth2Auth` initializes `grantType`, `issuerUrl`, `redirectUri`, `scopes`,
`storeTokens`, and `autoRefresh` via `useState(prop)`. Since `MCPServerForm`
doesn't pass the optional callbacks for those fields, they are effectively
uncontrolled — their values never flow back to the parent and will never reach
the API call. `useState` only reads its initializer once, so if the parent
re-renders with different props, the component ignores them.

The fix is to lift all OAuth fields into `MCPServerForm`'s state and make
`OAuth2Auth` a fully controlled component (no internal `useState` at all),
the same pattern used by `BearerTokenAuth` and `CustomHeadersAuth`.

**`resetForm()` doesn't reset OAuth extended fields**
This is a direct consequence of the above — `grantType`, `issuerUrl`,
`scopes`, etc. live inside `OAuth2Auth` local state, so `resetForm()` can't
reach them. Close the form with OAuth details filled in, reopen it — those
values persist. Fixing the mixed-state issue resolves this too.

**`key={index}` in `CustomHeadersAuth`**
Deleting a row from the middle of the headers list will cause React to reuse
the wrong DOM nodes, leading to inputs showing the wrong data. Please assign a
stable `id` to each header on creation (e.g. `crypto.randomUUID()`) and use
that as the key instead.

---

### 🟠 Should Fix

**Duplicate `CustomHeader` type**
`CustomHeader` is defined locally in `CustomHeadersAuth.tsx` AND exported from
`AdvancedSettings.tsx`. Once a stable `id` field is added (per the `key` fix),
one definition will drift. Please remove the local one and import from
`AdvancedSettings` (or a shared `types.ts`).

**`// Made with Bob` comment in `AdvancedSettings.tsx`**
This was flagged in #4561 and it's still at the bottom of the file. Please
remove it.

**`customHeaders` initialized with a blank row**
`MCPServerForm` initializes `customHeaders: [{ key: "", value: "" }]` even
when the user selects a different auth type. This blank row will be included
in the form state at submit time and may be serialized into the API request
as an empty custom header. Initialise to `[]` and handle the empty state
inside `CustomHeadersAuth` with a placeholder message.

---

### 🟡 Nice to Fix

- **OAuth client secret** should use `type="password"` for consistency with
  `BearerTokenAuth` — both are sensitive credentials.
- **Custom header values** are rendered as `type="text"` but frequently
  carry tokens/API keys. Consider masking or adding a show/hide toggle.
- **`oneTimeAuth` Figma spec** — per @a-effort's comment, the toggle should
  update label text color and show an inline alert when activated. A
  `// TODO` at minimum so it's not forgotten.
- **Auth field validation** — none of the new components validate their
  inputs on submit (empty bearer token, malformed header key, invalid token
  URL). This can result in silent API errors.

---

The OAuth state lift is the main piece of work here — once that's done
the reset issue resolves itself and the overall architecture will be solid.
